decision: Keep as the current statically validated bare-model candidate. It strengthens only coherent obstacle-free curve steering while preserving obstacle priority and the inherited speed/slew safety envelopes. Do not claim faster laps, completion improvement, SOTA or submission readiness until an authorized controlled multi-track evaluation passes the stability-first gate.
implementation: Route only bare state-dict inference through _CoherentCurveAttackController; explicit export, DrQ and HAIC routes remain unchanged.

When every sampled road-center row30,34,38,42,46,50,54 agrees on the curve direction, no current obstacle exists and the clear-exit gate is false, amplify the inherited steering request by20 percent, bounded by a0.06 increment and the existing0.48 cap.
Suppress amplification across the closed inherited-reversal protection interval where the inherited request is at most0.07 and the amplified request reaches at least0.07.
Write the actual candidate request back to _carry_steer_request so the inherited strong-steer target44 and steering-dependent throttle attenuation see the increased lateral demand.

Synchronize amplified distant-preview state so an immediately opposing obstacle restores the exact control action; current-obstacle geometry, urgency, cap0.32, target speeds and miss-latch behavior are unchanged.
Preserve the existing0.07 emitted-steering slew limit, clear-exit acceleration, curve targets, obstacle+sharp-curve target30, reset and lost-road recovery.

validation.independent_static_review: Independent review found and closed three pre-commit transition defects: near-field S-kink admission, stale amplified preview markers, and both open and exact-lower cases around the inherited0.07 reversal threshold. Final re-audit found no blocking defects and independently ran11 relevant tests.

isolated_package.result: exact-file package/import/reset/action smoke passed; this is not an official Linux, driving or submission evaluation

residual_risks: No authorized driving run measured whether stronger coherent-curve steering improves pace or preserves completion on unseen tracks.
The all-row image-space coherence gate cannot measure physical tire force, slip angle or obstacle clearance.
The extra steering slightly reduces gas through the unchanged inherited steering attenuation; real net lap-time effect is unknown.
SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf remain absent, so official evaluation, promotion and submission remain blocked.
